traditions.KJV: presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἐπὶ τὴν οἰκίαν νυκτός ·

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔ הָ בְּ כָל שְׂדֵ֖ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל

traditions.KJV: and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י עָשׂ֛וּ זִמָּ֥ה וּ נְבָלָ֖ה בְּ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

7.english_reference: Behold , ye [ are ] all children of Israel
